pool.text: Jonker Afrikaner settled at Windhoek and built a stone church for his community.
Windhoek was founded a second time by Major Curt von François.
The Windhoek Public Library was built next to the Alte Feste.
Kaiserstraße became the first paved road in Windhoek.
The city introduced the world's first potable reuse facility treating recycled sewage.
Windhoek formally received its town privileges on the anniversary date.
The Namibian general contract workers strike started from Windhoek.
The airport served 141,605 passengers, with the majority travelling on light aircraft.
The Reiterdenkmal statue was removed from its historical place next to Christuskirche.
The city had a total of 41,900 informal housing structures accommodating inhabitants.
A statue was removed from in front of the municipal grounds.
The population reached 486,186 and was growing due to migration.
